messages:
maria: deploy-bot blocked publish for payments image. ECR push returned provenance check fail - missing 'org.opencontainers.image.revision'. anyone from CI can look?

deploy-bot: [CI] publish rejected for image 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/payments:v2.1.3
Error: manifest validation failed: missing required annotation 'org.opencontainers.image.revision'
See: https://go.redwood/release-runbook#provenance

ajay: looking at the kaniko logs now, build step skipped LABELs due to new buildx cache flags. will confirm if we can rebuild fast.

olivia: good catch. note: current prod still on v2.1.2 digest, so no rollback needed yet - deploy was blocked at canary.

ben: two options: 1) republish corrected image with new tag v2.1.4 and let canary run; 2) if need immediate, retag previous digest to v2.1.3 and allow rollout. what's ECR immutability for 'payments'?

infra-oncall: checked, immutability is ON for payments repo (SHA pins required). can't overwrite v2.1.3. we can push a new tag. recommended: push v2.1.4 and update deployment to digest to be explicit.

ajay: i'll rebuild with labels and push as v2.1.4. build command i will run:
```
kaniko --context . --destination 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/payments:v2.1.4 \n  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision=git-commit-abcdef --label org.opencontainers.image.created=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
```

maria: deploy window is 23:00-02:00 UTC. ajay, can you have pushed image + deploy job queued before 01:30 UTC? if not, we fallback to manual rollback plan.

ajay: yes, rebuild and push ETA 20m. i'll post digest when ready.

deploy-bot: [Scheduler] canary for payments blocked until image available. will resume auto-deploy when new tag is pushed.

ben: once ajay posts digest we'll update release notes and set deployment to use imageDigest:sha256:<digest> with kubectl patch like:
```
kubectl -n payments set image deploy/payments payments=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/payments@sha256:<digest>
```
Then monitor logs and rollback if error rate > 2% for 10m.

olivia: i'll update release notes and post a short message to #product-notify after canary passes.

ajay: pushed. digest: sha256:111aaa222bbb333ccc444ddd555eee666fff777ggg888hhh999iii000jjj

deploy-bot: [CI] image uploaded and provenance OK. canary scheduled.

maria: thanks. keeping channel open for 30m while canary runs. :thumbsup: 

infra-oncall: reminder: we'll also record the root cause in the build-runbook. assigning to @ajay for follow-up.
